title: CmdPal: Dock - closing a dock window removes ShowDesktop helper hook

judgment.rationale: This ownership/lifetime boundary is already addressed by the active helper-isolation PR. Validate closing one of multiple docks there; do not propose an independent hook singleton redesign.
evidence: The author/assignee describes a static ShowDesktop helper whose teardown is not coordinated across DockWindow instances.
Existing #51569 isolates the WinEvent helper and adds WindowsEventsListener tests.
Upstream main 9e6593c34949: src/modules/cmdpal/Microsoft.CmdPal.UI/Dock/DockWindow.xaml.cs: ShowDesktop helper and DockWindow message handling are the reported shared boundary.
Retrieved open #51569 at 71b233c0a132: changes DockWindow, DockWindowManager, WindowsEventsListener and dedicated tests.
judgment.recommended_action: Use the linked existing owner/fix; do not start a competing change.
